title: ssh: skip known_hosts handling for machine connections
body:
Machine connections use ssh.InsecureIgnoreHostKey() so the host key is never verified. Yet ValidateAndConfigure still loaded ~/.ssh/known_hosts and derived HostKeyAlgorithms from it. A "@cert-authority *" marker then restricts the offered algorithms to cert types (e.g. ssh-ed25519-cert-v01@openssh.com) that the machine server never presents, failing the handshake before the callback runs:
     ssh: no common algorithm for host key; we offered:
     ["ssh-ed25519-cert-v01@openssh.com"], peer offered: ["rsa-sha2-512" ...]

Skip the known_hosts DB entirely for machine connections; regular connections keep the existing verification and algorithm filtering.

Fixes podman-container-tools/podman#27825
